title: Shape Alternates: Customize the Display of One Type or One Item | Orchard Core
description:
A content type or a single content item sometimes needs markup of its own, but editing a shared template or a module changes every page that uses it.

Shape alternates solve this. Orchard Core tries more specific template names before the shape type, so a file in the Views folder of a theme can target one content type, or one content item by its path, and the module stays untouched.

In this video:
• How a template is chosen: shape types, alternates and file names
• The alternates of a content item: content type, path and alias
• A template for every item of one content type
• A template for a single content item
• Finding the template that rendered a shape with the shape debug information
• Adding your own alternates from a template or from code

links.label: Templates and the alternates of content items
